description: A TypeScript mini task orchestration library: define task model, task status, task queue, support creating tasks, updating status, generating execution summary.

workers.description: Task model + state transitions: defines TaskStatus, TaskPriority, TaskInput, TaskRecord types and createTask, updateTaskStatus functions.
workers.taskDescription: Create src/taskTypes.ts with TaskStatus type ('pending'|'running'|'completed'|'failed'), TaskPriority type ('low'|'normal'|'high'), TaskInput interface (title:string, priority?:TaskPriority, tags?:string[]), and TaskRecord interface (id:string, title:string, status:TaskStatus, priority:TaskPriority, tags:string[], createdAt:string, updatedAt:string). Create src/createTask.ts with createTask(input: TaskInput): TaskRecord that trims title, defaults priority to 'normal', defaults tags to [], sets status to 'pending', generates a deterministic id, sets createdAt/updatedAt to ISO string. Create src/updateTaskStatus.ts with updateTaskStatus(task: TaskRecord, status: TaskStatus): TaskRecord that returns a new object with updated status and updatedAt, does not mutate original. Export all types and functions as named exports.
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 1 creates taskTypes.ts with TaskStatus, TaskPriority, TaskInput, TaskRecord type definitions; createTask.ts with createTask function applying defaults; updateTaskStatus.ts with immutable status transition function.

workers.description: Queue + summary: imports TaskStatus, TaskPriority, TaskInput, TaskRecord, createTask, updateTaskStatus from Worker 1; provides TaskQueue, createTaskQueue, addTaskToQueue, buildTaskSummary.
workers.taskDescription: Create src/taskQueue.ts with TaskQueue interface (tasks:TaskRecord[]), createTaskQueue(): TaskQueue returning empty queue, addTaskToQueue(queue:TaskQueue, input:TaskInput): TaskQueue that calls createTask(input) from Worker 1 and returns new queue object without mutating original. Create src/buildTaskSummary.ts with buildTaskSummary(queue:TaskQueue): string that includes total task count, count by status (pending/running/completed/failed), count by priority (low/normal/high), and high priority count. Export TaskQueue, createTaskQueue, addTaskToQueue, buildTaskSummary as named exports.
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 2 imports TaskStatus, TaskPriority, TaskInput, TaskRecord, createTask, updateTaskStatus from Worker 1, creates taskQueue.ts with immutable queue operations, and buildTaskSummary.ts with comprehensive summary generator.

acceptance.description: Worker 1 creates taskTypes.ts with TaskStatus, TaskPriority, TaskInput, TaskRecord type definitions; createTask.ts with createTask function applying defaults; updateTaskStatus.ts with immutable status transition function.

Worker 2 imports TaskStatus, TaskPriority, TaskInput, TaskRecord, createTask, updateTaskStatus from Worker 1, creates taskQueue.ts with immutable queue operations, and buildTaskSummary.ts with comprehensive summary generator.
Contract, honesty, drift, isolation, integration, token proof, and hash chain gates must pass in execution phase.
TypeScript typecheck: if tsc available, must pass; if unavailable, SKIPPED_ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE.
